decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch close to the core water-infrastructure offer and still shown on the website, it has enough recent investment and commitment behind it that management would likely continue it unless clear failure emerges.

This energy management system fits the firm's stated move toward digitally networked, efficient, and environmentally oriented infrastructure, so sunk development effort and strategic public commitment make withdrawal unlikely after only one year.

Because this 2024 product received its own webpage and sits close to the established portfolio, management is likely to justify and extend the launch rather than reverse course quickly in the absence of persistent negative evidence.
